name: list_events
description: List events in a calendar, optionally filtered by a date/time range. Returns an array of events with uid, summary, start, end, timezone and description. start/end are ISO 8601 with an offset for zoned, UTC or legacy fixed-offset values, a bare local time for floating values, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events. timezone is the IANA name, 'UTC', the legacy TZID as stored (e.g. 'UTC+03:00'), 'floating', null for all-day events, or the raw TZID when unknown.

calendar_name.description: Name of the calendar to list events from.

start.description: ISO 8601 datetime string for the start of the search range (optional). Offset-less values are read in the configured default timezone (UTC if unset).

end.description: ISO 8601 datetime string for the end of the search range (optional). Offset-less values are read in the configured default timezone (UTC if unset).
